store.summary: Lightweight TUI e-reader for EPUB, Markdown, and TXT
store.description: A distraction-free Rust TUI e-reader built for the CardputerZero 320x170 screen. Supports EPUB 2/3, Markdown, and TXT with hyphen-aware wrapping, Table of Contents, bookmarks, quick Markdown notes, in-book search, RSVP speed-reading, 4 low-glare themes, and online book search/download from Standard Ebooks, Project Gutenberg, and Internet Archive.
